text:
sam: Quick sync — we need a low-friction plan to introduce the new client "features" header that enables structured responses (v4). goal: avoid mass breakage, allow opt-in, and provide a tiny runtime shim for legacy clients.

maya: Agree. TLDR: opt-in header + server-side shim for older clients + per-tenant canary + telemetry events.

lucas: If header is opt-in, how do we detect older clients that can't send it? we should expose a capability probe endpoint or rely on UA sniffing?

irene: Don't do UA sniffing. we'll add a short-lived capability probe: POST /v1/capabilities (client_id) -> {supports_features: true/false}. cheap and explicit.

sam: +1 to probe. fallback: if no header and no probe record, runtime should serve legacy shape. shim behavior: translate new structured payload -> legacy top-level fields. small perf hit but ok for transition.

lucas: ok. propose header: X-Redwood-Client-Features: features=structured_resp;version=1. keep grammar simple.

maya: can we namespace the telemetry? event names like feature_flag.accepted, feature_flag.fallback, feature_flag.error with tags route/model/tenant.

sam: yes. add sampling at 1% for legacy clients to track regressions; 100% for new header flows.

irene: runtime implementation notes: shim should live close to response shaping layer (post-kv-cache). we can implement a fast path: if header present -> use structured serializer; else if probe cache says supports -> headerless structured path; else -> legacy serializer.

lucas: concurrency question: structured responses are larger (metadata). watch tokenization/perf. add a perf counter: resp.size.bytes and resp.serialize.ms per-path.

maya: ops requirements: need an escape hatch flag in config: rts.features.structured_resp = off|opt-in|forced. default opt-in.

sam: rollout plan: 1) merge probe endpoint + telemetry + config flag behind off; 2) implement shim with forced=off but test in staging; 3) enable opt-in for internal clients 10% canary; 4) 25/50/100% for opt-in; 5) after 6 weeks and metric stability, flip forced for compatible tenants; 6) announce deprecation of legacy shape with 6 months lead.

irene: add automated rollback triggers: increase in error.rate > 3x baseline OR latency.p50 increase > 20% OR 7-day user errors for any tenant. those should immediately flip that tenant to legacy path.

lucas: how do we handle third-party SDKs? they may not call probe. we should publish a tiny compatibility client that sets the header and calls probe.

maya: docs: snippet for header + probe. example:
```
# probe
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"client_id":"my-sdk-1"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/capabilities
# header
curl -H "X-Redwood-Client-Features: features=structured_resp;version=1" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \\n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

sam: good. let's also add a short lived migration telemetry tag: migration.wave=<id> so we can correlate.

irene: operation detail: probe results cached for 24h; invalidation on tenant-level config change. storage in small in-memory map with tombstones.

lucas: testing: create a stress test that exercises shim and direct paths. include golden-file checks for legacy and structured outputs.

maya: security: header is fine but ensure no sensitive info in structured metadata. do a quick PII review.

sam: rollout owner: @maya for week 1-4, @lucas for perf/metrics, @irene for ops and rollback hooks. dev-deploy-bot: when we push the probe endpoint branch, please post the deploy link.

dev-deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/probe-endpoint -> staging (build 2483). CI: 12/14 green. :rocket:

ops-bot: FYI: added canary alert dashboards: "features.flag.fallback_rate" and "features.flag.latency".

sam: last note — keep the shim minimal: no behavior changes, only shape translation. no extra heuristics. we want predictable rollback.

lucas: ack. i'll start the shim PR and include perf counters and a toggle.

maya: i'll draft the public migration doc + SDK snippet.

irene: i'll wire the rollback runbook into the runbook repo and add the probe docs.

sam: thanks all. follow-up sync Wednesday 10am to review staging metrics. :white_check_mark:
